verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI documents per-load engine overrides for GPU offload ratio and context length (`lms load [--gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0] [--context-length=1-N]`), so it does expose some low-level engine settings beyond fixed defaults. Nothing in the evidence shows memory locking (mlock) or mmap controls. missing for 10: documented mlock/memory-locking toggle, documented mmap toggle, broader engine-parameter reference, independent hands-on corroboration of low-level overrides.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
